description: A PHP script providing functions to generate additional details for case records in the SuiteCRM system, including linking descriptions and resolutions with dynamic links for editing and viewing the case.

methods.name: additionaldetailscase
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls additionalDetailsaCase to generate a summary string for a case record.

methods.name: additionalDetailsaCase
